ClaimInput.title: ClaimInput

Confidence.description: An optional assessment aid with an explicit method; never a substitute for evidence.
Confidence.title: Confidence

CriticInfoModel.description: The public description of one registered critic.
CriticInfoModel.title: CriticInfoModel

CriticListResponse.description: Every registered critic, with its declared scope.
CriticListResponse.title: CriticListResponse

CriticRun.description: A persisted critic execution. Matches the SPEC §5.6 field set.
CriticRun.title: CriticRun

CriticRunResponse.description: The outcome of a critic run request.
CriticRunResponse.title: CriticRunResponse

CriticRunResult.description: The persisted outcome of one critic run, as returned to the caller.
CriticRunResult.title: CriticRunResult

Event.description: A normalized observation submitted by or about a monitored system.
Event.title: Event

EventBatchRequest.description: A bounded batch of raw event payloads validated item by item.
EventBatchRequest.title: EventBatchRequest

EventInput.description: A normalized observation submitted by a producer (SPEC §5.2).
EventInput.title: EventInput

EvidenceInput.description: An evidence item or reference submitted by a producer (SPEC §5.4).
EvidenceInput.title: EvidenceInput

EvidenceItem.description:
An evidence record or reference.

Both inline and reference-only evidence are supported. Large or restricted payloads should
be referenced rather than copied into findings.
EvidenceItem.title: EvidenceItem

EvidenceVerification-Input.description: The result of checking an evidence item's integrity or provenance.
EvidenceVerification-Input.title: EvidenceVerification

EvidenceVerification-Output.description: The result of checking an evidence item's integrity or provenance.
EvidenceVerification-Output.title: EvidenceVerification

FieldDetail.description: A field-level validation failure. Never contains the offending value.
FieldDetail.title: FieldDetail

Finding.description: A composed finding with explicit evidence links (SPEC §5.5).
Finding.title: Finding

MonitoredSystem.description:
A system registered for observation.

``metadata`` is descriptive only. Credentials, tokens, private keys, and raw secrets are
forbidden there; the validator rejects any key that looks like secret material. This is
safety invariant 8 at the domain boundary.
MonitoredSystem.title: MonitoredSystem

Period-Input.description: The time window a claim or evidence item applies to.
Period-Input.title: Period

Period-Output.description: The time window a claim or evidence item applies to.
Period-Output.title: Period

PrincipalRef.description:
A reference to an actor, subject, or producer.

The identity is self-asserted unless a separate trusted channel establishes it.
PrincipalRef.title: PrincipalRef

Reasoning.description:
Inspectable reasoning with explicit premises and inference.

``observations`` are recorded facts or direct readings. ``inferences`` are NYX's
conclusions drawn from those observations. They are stored separately on purpose.
Reasoning.title: Reasoning

RecommendedAction.description:
A recommendation for an authorised human or policy gate.

``is_recommendation`` is pinned to ``True``: the MVP never performs an external action, so
NYX output can only ever be advice.
RecommendedAction.title: RecommendedAction

Scope-Input.description: The system, artifact, environment, period, and conditions a statement applies to.
Scope-Input.title: Scope

Scope-Output.description: The system, artifact, environment, period, and conditions a statement applies to.
Scope-Output.title: Scope

SystemPage.description: A cursor page of monitored systems.
SystemPage.title: SystemPage

get.description:
Retrieve one finding, including its evidence links and limitations.

The finding's own fields are returned; restricted evidence payloads are not inlined here
merely because the caller can read the finding (SPEC §9.2).
Liveness: the process is up and serving requests.

Readiness: the database is reachable and migrations are at head.

Returns ``503`` with a structured, secret-free error when not ready.
List systems visible to the caller with deterministic cursor pagination.
